title: Invoice ledger: arbitrary invoices with lines, totals, due dates and balances
description:
As an operator, I raise an invoice for anything (a subscription period, one-off work, a correction), so that invoiced clients can be billed without a Stripe subscription.

Feature: Invoices
  Scenario: Raise an invoice
    Given an account with a billing profile and an operator holding accounts:admin:billing
    When the operator creates a draft with lines (description, quantity, unit amount in minor units, optional billing line and period), currency and due date, then issues it
    Then billing/invoices/<uuid>.json holds subtotal, total and balance equal to total, status issued, an invoice number from the sequence, and the journal records draft and issue
  Scenario: Issue through Stripe
    Given a profile with a Stripe customer and the processor enabled
    When the operator issues the invoice via Stripe
    Then a Stripe invoice with collection_method send_invoice is created from the same lines, its id is stored as the external reference, and later Stripe payments reach the ledger only through the webhook mirror
  Scenario: Issue manually
    Given no Stripe customer
    When the operator issues the invoice manually
    Then the invoice is issued with issuedVia manual, no external call is made, and payments are recorded by hand
  Scenario: Void
    Given an issued invoice with no allocations
    When the operator voids it
    Then status void, balance zero, the number is not reused
  Scenario: Immutable once issued
    Given an issued invoice
    When anyone tries to edit its lines
    Then it is refused; corrections are a new invoice or a credit (reversal) record referencing it
  Scenario: Arithmetic
    Given lines with quantities and unit amounts
    Then totals are integer minor units, sum exactly, and no floating point is used anywhere in billing

Done looks like: `billing/invoices.ts`, `billing/money.ts` (integer money with currency), the number sequence as a conditional-write counter file `billing/sequences/invoice-number.json`, operator routes under `/v1/account-directory/operator/accounts/{id}/invoices[/{invoice}]` and actions `issue`, `void`; customer read of own invoices on the portal BFF.

Data touched: `prospectus-central/billing/invoices/`, `billing/sequences/`, `billing/journal/`.

Specs: `features/billing-ledger.feature` (invoice scenarios); `billing/invoices.test.ts`, `billing/money.test.ts` (property-style tests on rounding and sums); concurrency test for the number sequence.

Open questions this story cannot settle: tax lines (1), currency (2), numbering and PDF for manual invoices (7), write-offs (5). Build with tax lines modelled but empty and USD as the only accepted currency until answered.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Ryan's decisions 2026-10-31 (see the epic comment):
- USD only, and no tax lines (total = subtotal).
- Default net 30 with an optional per-account override; no late fees.
- Sequential invoice numbers from a configurable starting value.
- Every invoice renders a PDF, manual ones included.
- One combined invoice per client per period, with each billing line (site deployment or any other product) as its own line item.
- Only admins may write off (mark `uncollectible`).
